title: Outreach scratch - Jordan (morning plan)
content:
Morning checklist / goals (today)
- Block 9:00-10:30 AM: outbound dials (focus: mid-market) 
- Block 11:00-12:00 PM: discovery follow-ups + calendar push
- Block 2:00-3:00 PM: demo preps & AE sync
- Daily targets: 40 dials, 12 outreaches (email/LI), 3 qualified conversations
- Must log every outcome to HubSpot immediately after call (tag: 'first-touch-2026-03')

Priority accounts (ordered)
1) Nimbus Health - CISO Emily Park (warm from webinar)
   - Last activity: downloaded compliance whitepaper 2026-03-05
   - Objective: secure 20-min intro to discuss private deployment options and audit logging
   - Next step: call at 9:15 AM, if on voicemail send follow-up email template A (below) and task 2-day follow-up
   - Notes to self: emphasize KMS/HSM integrations and audit retention features

2) BrightCart (headless commerce) - Eng manager: Raul Mendez
   - Last: demo request via site 2026-03-08 (no show to scheduled demo)
   - Objective: re-engage, confirm pain: latency/cost per token
   - Next step: 9:40 AM call; if interested, book AE demo 30-min slot Tues/Wed

3) AtlasDocs - Head of Platform: Sara Kim (cold->warm via intro from Mira)
   - Last: intro email 2026-03-10, replied asking for pricing bands
   - Objective: qualify deployment preference (hosted vs private), ARR range, procurement timeline
   - Next step: send quick pricing snippet + ask to lock 15-min sync; follow-up 11:30 AM

4) Greenline Logistics - CTO: Akash Patel
   - Opportunity: looking at quantization / batch savings for inference (cost-driven)
   - Action: prepare cost-savings one-pager, mention Redwood Optimize features and batching examples

Quick call scripts / hooks (use natural language, adapt)
- Intro (3s): "Hi [name], Jordan Woods from Redwood Inference — we help engineering teams make LLMs predictable and cheaper in production. Quick 30s?"
- Discovery trigger questions: "What are your current LLM costs / biggest pain? Latency targets? Any compliance constraints?"
- If procurement asks: "We support hosted, dedicated reserved capacity, and private/VPC installs — which would you prefer?"
- Closing ask: "Would you be open to a short demo to see typical 3–5x token-cost reductions and latency profiles?"

Email templates (short, two variants)
- Template A (voicemail / follow-up):
  Subject: Quick follow-up — private deployment for Nimbus Health
  Hi Emily,
  Sorry I missed you — left a voicemail. We helped a healthcare platform cut inference costs by ~60% while keeping audit logs and SOC controls. Can we do a 20-min call this week to map to your compliance needs?
  Cheers,
  Jordan

- Template B (pricing reply):
  Subject: Pricing snapshot + next step
  Sara —
  Thanks for the ask. Quick snapshot: hosted API starts at $X/month for low-volume; Dedicated reserved starts from ~$Y/month depending on GPU type; Private deployments are packaged + support. Happy to send a tailored band if you share your target qps / monthly tokens. 15-min call to align?
  — Jordan

Follow-up cadence rules (my personal system)
- After first contact: +2 days (email), +5 days (LinkedIn message), +12 days (call again), then monthly nurture
- If prospect replies with a date: always create calendar event + set reminder 1 day before

Pipeline quick notes (opps to watch)
- OPP-7841 (BrightCart) — expected ACV $45k, stuck at demo stage; risk: procurement COMMS; owner: Jordan/AEs
- OPP-7990 (Greenline) — cost-savings case study assigned to Solutions Eng (SE: Priya), next: custom bench test by 2026-03-20

Objections cheat-sheet (rapid responses)
- "We already use vendor X": Ask what specifically they like/don't like; position Redwood on cost + predictable SLOs + private option for compliance
- "Too expensive": run conservative cost-savings example (quantization + batching) and propose pilot week with metrics
- "Security concerns": call out private deployment, KMS integrations, audit trail, SOC2 mention (link to compliance doc in Slack)

Admin / reminders
- Send Nimbus follow-up email if no answer after call (task created in HubSpot)
- Prep Greenline cost-savings one-pager before 2 PM
- Update SFDC stage for BrightCart after demo follow-up
- Add 'privacy & compliance' talking points to snippets doc (link later)

End-of-day log (template to paste into HubSpot notes)
- Activities: [calls made], [emails sent], [meetings held]
- Outcomes: [qualified / disqualified / demo booked / pricing sent]
- Next steps: [concrete next task with owner and due date]

Personal notes to self
- Keep intros <30s, call to action always calendar-focused
- Use concrete examples (percent cost savings, latency ms numbers) rather than vague benefits
- If conversation drifts to model choice -> park and say: "we're model agnostic for serving; let's focus on infra and costs first"

Unresolved questions / follow-ups for AE sync
- Need latest Redwood Optimize benchmark vs competitor X for 16k seqs (ask SE team)
- Clarify discount bands for Dedicated below $50k MRR (pricing ops)

Scratch area (quick jot)
- Mira intro -> Sara (send calendar invite template)
- Voice mailbox script tweak: open softer, leave exact CTA
- Remember to export call recordings for training clip (consent check)

— end of scratchpad —
